tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Get Scrykeeper intelligence for one Royal Road fiction ID. Observed readers are sampled graph observations and are not total readership. Anonymous demo access is available; higher limits are available at https://scrykeeper.com/api/access.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Get a resolved Scrykeeper author identity, known works and deduplicated observed audience footprint. Known works are not guaranteed to be a complete bibliography.

tools.name: search_market
tools.description: Search Scrykeeper's Royal Road market dataset by genre, lifecycle, followers, sampled observed readers, update recency and known commercial mapping. commercial='none' means no accepted mapping in Scrykeeper, not unpublished.

tools.name: get_data_context
tools.description: Return Scrykeeper's current data coverage, source-specific freshness, methodology and limitations. Use this when interpreting reader, author or commercial metrics.
